question: Which tile values, flag consumers, coordinate conversion and read-length boundaries are fixed by the selected version 1.3 named-map path?

scope.boundary: Static selected-path evidence for the supported 32-by-32 image. Consumer order is not an exhaustive runtime first-use inventory. No runtime execution, content-byte inspection or writer contract.

dependencies.use: RVA-F-0070 supplies named-map selection, dimension identity and loader admission.
Retains the earlier bounded DDS negative; tile observations do not specify texture payloads.
Accepted stride-40 unit-coordinate classifier and later terrain-7 normalization at /boundary/currentTerrainClassifier and /boundary/namedMapDepthOrdering.
Accepted artifact flag ingress and conditional consumption at /boundary/ingress and /boundary/consumption.

terrainValues.encoding: 0x82D0B27C..0x82D0B290 masks the file byte to its low nibble and stores that byte without a range check or clamp. All values 0..15 pass this local store.

specialValues.fact: Terrain 0 bypasses the additional halfword flag 0x10 set; file 0x10 still sets 0x400.
The depth reconstruction treats terrain 0 separately from every nonzero value; its clamp 0..2 at 0x82D0B640..0x82D0B65C applies to a derived depth byte, not terrain type.
The next component pass calls 0x82D03190; its 0x82D00290 child can change terrain 7 to 0 at 0x82D003F4 under the accepted same-sign-neighbor guard.
The selected food accessor reads the terrain byte, substitutes 8 when halfword flag 1 is set, and indexes a signed-byte yield at 0x82F771E0+29*type at 0x82CF1D94 without a local terrain-range check.

existingNames.result: This existing Research record names values 0, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. No additional name or new enum is assigned here.

terrainValues.qualification: Local nibble admission and indexed loads do not establish valid authoring values, safe table membership or final retained terrain.

halfwordFlags.producer: 0x82D0B2C8..0x82D0B320 ORs 0x400, also ORs 0x10 for nonzero terrain, then clears 0x80 in F[i].
halfwordFlags.consumer: 0x82D0E3DC..0x82D0E414 computes the same 40*x+y cell, tests 0x400 and selects 0x82D05210(player,x,y) when set. The accepted knights-templar-discovery-event ingress names this the artifact-presence branch; its separate selected consumption clears 0x400.
halfwordFlags.secondConsumer: The accepted resource callback 0x82D7FCB0 tests current F[i] at 0x82D7FDE0..0x82D7FE18 and calls 0x82DD3C48 only when 0x10 is set and 0x400 is clear on its negative-resource arm.
halfwordFlags.qualification: The loader's nonzero-terrain 0x10 write initially coexists with 0x400, which suppresses that particular callback arm. The same nonzero-terrain arm also increments a loader counter at [r15+4] and advances an MSVC-style linear congruential state at [r15+0] (multiplier 0x343FD, increment 0x269EC3); those side effects are unexplained here, so 0x10 is not shown to be a pure flag. The 0x80 clear at 0x82D0B314 runs on both the zero and nonzero arms. This is not a universal semantic name for 0x10 or a proof of all artifact effects.

coordinateMarkers.producer: 0x82D0B298..0x82D0B2B4 appends file 0x20 markers while local count n<8: U32[0x830E343C+4*n]=31-c and U32[0x830E345C+4*n]=r.
coordinateMarkers.consumerIdentity: The accepted civilization-placement record uses these exact two eight-word arrays as coordinates at 0x82D03078/0x82D03084; setup reads them at 0x82D231B4/0x82D231B8.
coordinateMarkers.bounds: Markers are visited in file order. The local append has no deduplication or terrain predicate; markers after the eighth are ignored. No direct clear of the two arrays or fill of unmarked entries appears in this owner.
coordinateMarkers.qualification: This binds a starting-coordinate storage seam, not actual player assignment, successful placement, minimum required marker count or an exhaustive array-consumer census. File 0x20 is not halfword flag 0x20.

edgePairs.producer: 0x82D0AFC0..0x82D0B01C maps file 0x40 to E[i]|=2,E[i+40]|=8 and file 0x80 to E[i]|=4,E[i-1]|=1. The paired bits occupy neighboring cells in a separate byte plane.
edgePairs.firstLocalConsumer: 0x82D0B06C..0x82D0B0C0 counts current 2,current 4,E[i+40]&4,E[i-1]&2. Exactly one incidence admits endpoint-dependent additions of byte bits 0x10,0x20,0x40,0x80 at 0x82D0B0C4..0x82D0B1F8.
edgePairs.laterConsumer: 0x82CF1E40..0x82CF1EAC reads E[40*x+y] and counts its set bits before the selected conditional food increment; this does not name the edge geometry.
edgePairs.combinationBoundary: The loader does not reject either high-bit pair or their combination. Neighbor writes and endpoint additions can combine at one E cell; a safe content-level combination set is not established.
edgePairs.edges: There is no local clipping or wrapping around the initial E[i+40] and E[i-1] stores. At outer row31, i+40 reaches padding row32; at column-coordinate0 the previous-byte store crosses the row boundary, including E[-1] for row0. This differs from the later terrain-neighbor pass's first-axis wrap and second-axis clipping.

orientation.fileDefinition: Zero-based file byte index j=32*r+c, with 0<=r,c<32.
orientation.mapping: 0x82D0AF84..0x82D0B038 and 0x82D0B214..0x82D0B340 produce i=40*r+(31-c). Using the accepted native tile-consumer convention i=40*x+y, internal(x,y)=(r,31-c).
orientation.consumerJoin: 0x82CF1CF4..0x82CF1D94 forms 40*incoming-r3+incoming-r4 for the same terrain and flag planes. 0x82D0E354/0x82D0E358 retains its second and third arguments and 0x82D0E3DC..0x82D0E3F8 forms the same index. The accepted currentTerrainClassifier joins that convention to signed unit coordinates.
orientation.qualification: The two globals 0x82F77364 and 0x82F77448 both contain 32. No support for a non-square or resized map is inferred. Player-facing display orientation remains runtime-only.

lengthBoundary.fileRead: 0x82D0AF44..0x82D0AF80 requests the dimension product 1024 into SP+416 through either 0x82E48590 or 0x82D38448, then enters conversion at 0x82D0AF84 without testing the returned count.
lengthBoundary.selectedArchiveReader: 0x82E485D0..0x82E485E4 reduces the requested count to the entry's remaining recorded bytes. 0x82E48648/0x82E48664 dispatch seek/read through current child slots 0x2C/0x30; 0x82E48674..0x82E48678 advances the entry cursor by returned count.
lengthBoundary.selectedStreamReader: 0x82D38460..0x82D384C8 checks stream state, then dispatches child slot 8 or calls 0x82D38360. Those delivery implementations are not closed here.
lengthBoundary.negative: The complete loader owner contains no second map-file read, expected-length equality test, footer read or footer rejection. It does not request bytes after the dimension product. This excludes only a direct footer contract in that owner.
lengthBoundary.bufferLookahead: The endpoint phase conditionally reads buffer[(r+2)*32-y], buffer[(r+1)*32-y] and buffer[(r+2)*32-y-1] at 0x82D0B0E0, 0x82D0B12C, 0x82D0B180 and 0x82D0B1D0. These addresses can exceed the requested 0..1023 span, reaching index 1056. They are stack-buffer reads, not delivery of a file footer.
lengthBoundary.shortFile: No direct initialization of the requested source-buffer span precedes the read, and no caller check rejects a short return. Conditional on normal returning callees and valid storage, conversion proceeds over the fixed grid; undelivered bytes and unchecked lookahead have no established value.
lengthBoundary.qualification: Actual archive/stream targets, failure delivery, implicit padding, exceptions and upstream size checks remain unresolved. Neither footer acceptance nor deterministic short-file behavior is proved.

currentEvidence.method: Sequential foreground read-only function, reference and raw-word queries with exact-owner generated corroboration and pinned-flat-image word comparison.
currentEvidence.repairQualification: A disposable project repaired [0x827F7C50,0x827F7CF0): 40 slots patched, 15 noreturn flags cleared, zero rebuild errors. Selected query words outside the repaired thunks matched the pinned image. Some bodies still truncate at modeled noreturn helpers or unsupported instructions; their decompiler closure is not used. Original save/restore ABI, normal helper return, valid nonaliasing storage and retained inputs are conditions, not runtime observations.

boundedNegative.references: Exact modeled references were zero for both marker-array bases and one for the byte-edge base. Known split-address producers remain visible in raw/generated code, so these inventories do not exclude consumers.
boundedNegative.range: No terrain-range rejection or terrain clamp exists in the selected nibble-store path or food-table indexing prefix. This does not prove a15-entry or16-entry terrain definition table.

unresolved: Declared terrain-definition table length, complete valid terrain domain and names for values outside the cited canonical discriminator record.

All consumers and complete semantics of halfword0x400/0x10, the purpose of the loader counter and linear congruential state advanced on the nonzero-terrain arm, safe edge-mask combinations and edge-content constraints.
Actual assignment and retention of marked starts, behavior for fewer than eight markers and all downstream coordinate-array consumers.
Player-facing display orientation and support for other gameplay dimensions.
Complete open/archive/stream size and delivery contracts, deterministic short-file behavior and safe acceptance of trailing bytes.
guards: Static version1.3 evidence does not establish execution, successful authored-map loading, save behavior or multiplayer parity.
Keep terrain bytes, halfword flags, byte edge masks and file marker bits distinct.
Do not transfer another platform's flag names, DDS rules or display axes to this image.
Do not treat a successful query, nibble store or ignored read result as an authoring validator.
conclusion: The selected path fixes the 32-by-32 file-to-native conversion, uncensored low-nibble store, marker-array writes, separate edge-pair plane and one 1024-byte delivery request. Selected consumers narrow terrain 0/7/8 and artifact/callback flag behavior. Unsafe boundary lookahead, incomplete table domains and unresolved delivery prevent a safe general named-map writer contract.
